summary: QuasarEdge Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closing of the full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option following its April 16, 2026 IPO of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, raising $100M gross. On April 21, 2026, an additional 1,500,000 units were sold, increasing total proceeds. The filing includes an unaudited pro forma balance sheet as of April 21, 2026, reflecting the trust and working capital adjustments. This is a routine IPO-related event, not a special situation; no business combination, tender offer, or strategic action is announced. No special-situation category applies.
